name: client-python-label-aware-selective-collection
instr:
Allow callers to restrict Prometheus collection by emitted sample names and label expressions through one immutable selection model. Selection should have identical meaning for direct collection, HTTP exposition, multiprocess metrics, and Graphite publishing while avoiding work for sources that cannot contribute selected samples. Existing unselected collection remains fully compatible.

An empty `CollectionSelector` is unrestricted, and later mutation of constructor inputs cannot alter it. `LabelMatcher` equality, inequality, regular-expression, and negative-regular-expression operations treat missing labels as empty strings, with each negative operation the logical complement of its positive counterpart; malformed expressions raise `InvalidMatcher`, a `ValueError`, before collection begins. Every selected collector preserves metric-family metadata and surviving sample order, omits empty families, and leaves established unrestricted behavior unchanged. Process and multiprocess collection avoid reading or decoding sources excluded by metric names, while requested-source failures retain their existing effects. Label matching occurs after gauge and histogram aggregation, preserving histogram relationships and producing samples equivalent to corresponding local metrics. Legacy no-argument collectors remain usable through registries, exposition, and Graphite; their results are filtered afterward, and exceptions from their implementations, including `TypeError`, propagate unchanged
